Welcome in {worldName}, {masterName}.

Explore the world, build yourself an empire, catch the most difficult Bestia.
The world ahead is yours to explore.

Good luck! You will need it.
Well met, traveller. I have nothing to offer you yet - come back once I do.

Welcome traveller,

Since you are new to this world you need to learn the most basic skills first.
When you open your Skills window. The first entry there is [b]Basic Skill[/b].

[table=2]
[cell]Lv. 1[/cell][cell]Trade with other players[/cell]
[cell]Lv. 2[/cell][cell]Speak - every channel, including the one around you[/cell]
[cell]Lv. 3[/cell][cell]Use trade posts[/cell]
[cell]Lv. 4[/cell][cell]Sit down and recover twice as fast[/cell]
[cell]Lv. 5[/cell][cell]Form parties, and open every other skill tree[/cell]
[/table]

Every level you gain is one point to put into the skill tree.
A sturdy workbench, freshly raised. There is nothing to make here yet.
You are in {town}. I keep the {trade} here.
Not today. Come back another time.
